title: Motor imagery BCI dataset with pupillometry augmentation
description: EEG recordings from 30 healthy participants performing a two-class motor imagery task (left-hand grasping imagery versus rest) with simultaneous pupillometry. Data were acquired with a 32-channel BioSemi ActiveTwo system at 512 Hz, with two runs of 25 auditory-cued trials per participant. This BIDS derivative was regenerated with a corrected MOABB loader and supports evaluating whether task-evoked pupil diameter changes improve motor imagery BCI classification.
methods_description: 32-channel EEG was recorded with a BioSemi ActiveTwo system (sintered Ag/AgCl active electrodes, CMS/DRL reference) at 512 Hz. Each participant completed two experiments of 25 trials, each stored as an XDF file. Trials lasted 6 s and used auditory cues for left-hand grasping imagery versus rest. Reference analyses used 8-30 Hz bandpass filtering, CSP and pupil diameter features, and LDA classification with 10-fold within-subject cross-validation.
